title: Pole Test for Assessing Motor Functions in Mice
author: Amandine EVEN
materials: Start recording with the camera using the Capture software (RRID:SCR_016047, version 2.4), 60 FPS.

steps.title: Acclimate Mice
steps.instruction: Acclimate the mice in the testing room for 1 hour before starting the experiment.

steps.title: Position Mouse on Pole
steps.instruction: Place the mouse at the top of the pole in a head-up position.

substeps.instruction: Hold the mouse on the surface of your hand
Bring the mouse to the top of the pole

steps.title: Acclimate Mouse to Pole
steps.instruction: Allow the mouse to acclimate to the cage for approximately 20 seconds.

steps.title: Perform Pole Test Trials
steps.instruction: Conduct the pole test for 3 trials, with 10 minutes of resting between each trial.

steps.title: Record Performance Metrics
steps.instruction: Use a media video player to analyze and record the following time metrics, with a maximum duration of 120s for descent:

substeps.instruction: Record the time required for the mouse to turn (from the moment the mouse is alone on the pole until it is completely turned around)
Record the time necessary for the mouse to climb down completely (from the moment the mouse is completely turned around until both front paws touch the ground)
Record the total time required for the mouse to descend to the floor level

steps.title: Post-Test Cleanup
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its home cage and clean the metal rod before testing the next mouse.
